# Documentation Style Rules

## Language

- Write all documentation in English.

## Tone

- Be concise and easy to read.
- Use factual, direct wording.
- Avoid hype, sales language, and unnecessary filler.

## Scope and Format

- Keep sections short and practical.
- Focus on decisions, constraints, and actionable steps.
- Prefer simple bullet lists over long paragraphs.
